title: Aliens have two sexes and eliminate waste

tellings.quote: >> Um they do have female and male.

plain: A former Air Force sergeant named Dan Sherman, who says he took telepathic messages from aliens for the NSA between 1990 and 1993, says he learned that the beings "do have female and male" and that they eliminate bodily waste. He tells Michels it came from his time in that work, at a place he calls Base 2, and it would mean the beings are living creatures much like us rather than machines.
